subject: reasoning
question: A - B means A is the sister of B, A × B means A is the mother of B, A ÷ B means A is the father of B, A + B means A is the brother of B What is the relation in A × B + C?

options.text: A is the mother of C
B is the father of C
C is the mother of B
B is the brother of A

solution:

Given: A × B + C

It means:

A is the Mother of B

B is the Brother of C

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/947c5383c2f5de0262092f9b0cb47f5ddb4491f5d84488afb04643bcf5e10191.png] 

So, A is the mother of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
